OTT.head: Anybody’s game
OTT.body: Ottawa is on the second night of a back-to-back, but they have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. For the Senators, the difference could be a penalty kill that holds up.

STL.head: A genuine toss-up
STL.body: Ottawa is on the second night of a back-to-back, but they have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. For the Blues, the difference could be keeping shots to a minimum.

items.text: The Blues have been without Logan Mailloux all season.
The Senators are newly without William Eklund, have been without Jonas Johansson since Oct 6, and have had to make do without Jake Sanderson all season. Samuel Ersson is expected to start.
Jake Neighbours has four goals in six games against Ottawa since 2023-24.
Drake Batherson is one goal from passing Radek Bonk for ninth on the Senators’ all-time goals list.
